dreams.title: The warm house beyond the hill
dreams.text: I crossed a dark field toward an old house with amber windows. A fox waited beside the hearth and did not seem afraid of me.

dreams.title: Kitchen of my grandmother
dreams.text: A kitchen opened into a huge night sky. There was bread on the table and a small red fox beneath the chair.

dreams.title: Fire on the hill
dreams.text: I climbed toward a stone cottage. Smoke rose from the chimney although nobody was there. Inside, a fire burned without fuel.
